description: Plan a brief subscribe overlay about two-thirds through a Short, after an optional hook, in a platform-safe lower-third. Local-only; never changes Premiere.

at_ratio.description: Placement as a fraction of duration; defaults to 2/3.

brand.description: Channel brand kit. cafe must not reuse watch_club fonts, name cards, or speaker colors.

copy.description: Optional overlay text. Defaults to a brand-appropriate subscribe line.

frame_rate.description: Sequence frame rate used to snap times to frames; defaults to 30.

hold_seconds.description: How long the prompt stays on screen; defaults to 2.

hook_end_seconds.description: If the hook ends later than the default placement, the CTA starts after the hook.

name: plan_short_subscribe_cta

data.description: Tool-specific result data when ok is true.

error.description: Failure detail when ok is false.

title: Plan Short Subscribe Cta
